name: Oak Ridge Reservation Natural Resource Damages Restoration Grant

funder.name: Tennessee Department of Environment and Conservation

summary: Tennessee Oak Ridge Reservation NRDAR grants for restoration projects that create ecological, groundwater and recreational benefits in affected HUC 12 watersheds.

geography.label: State of Tennessee within HUC 12 watersheds identified in the RFP

reporting: Applicants must show capacity to administer, track and report awarded funds; in-kind leverage must be tracked during the project and documented in the final report.

status.quote: The application opens on October 19, 2026. Submissions are due at 4:00 p.m. CST, January 22, 2027.

opens.quote: The application opens on October 19, 2026. Submissions are due at 4:00 p.m. CST, January 22, 2027.

deadline.quote: The application opens on October 19, 2026. Submissions are due at 4:00 p.m. CST, January 22, 2027.

applicant_types.quote: The grant funding opportunity is open to public entities such as a unit of state or local government, including a county, municipality, local public authority, school district, special district, district commission, regional government, any agency or instrumentality of government, and state authorities, and non-public entities

geography.quote: be within the State of Tennessee within the HUC 12 watershed(s) identified in the RFP;

access.quote: If you are interested in applying for this grant offering, please register and apply using the TDEC Online Grants System.

window.quote: The application opens on October 19, 2026. Submissions are due at 4:00 p.m. CST, January 22, 2027.
